rules.evidence: NTSB MDB Release Notes 3.0 states that cm_inPC was added to AVALL monthly/weekly downloads on 2024-03-01 and back-filled for historical records.
rules.rule: Never admit cm_inPC at a simulated cutoff before 2024-03-01 merely because the current AVALL snapshot contains a back-filled value. Record-level availability at or after that date still requires evidence appropriate to the backtest use.

rules.evidence: NTSB announced expanded aviation data and CSV/JSON downloads with additional fields on 2023-07-17.
rules.rule: The product-level release bounds these added search/download capabilities; it does not prove that any particular field/value was publicly present before the release or on a specific historical record at the same date.

rules.evidence: NTSB announced the public launch of CAROL on 2020-10-13 and described aviation investigations since 2008 as available subject to migration caveats.
rules.rule: CAROL launch is a datasource-level lower bound only. It must not be converted into an exact record or field publication timestamp.

default_rule.rule: If no dated official release, archived snapshot, report publication, or equivalent immutable evidence proves historical public availability, the field/value remains unknown and is excluded from strict PIT backtests.
